tools.name: blip_caption_image
tools.description: Generate a natural-language caption for an image using BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training). Useful for auto-describing generated outputs, building reverse prompts from reference images, or tagging history items. Returns a plain text string.

prompt.description: Optional text prefix to condition the caption (e.g. 'a photograph of')

tools.name: blip_is_available
tools.description: Return true if the blip plugin's required packages (torch, transformers) are installed
